_comment: Single source of truth for the dictionary-mode dropdown, shared by search/js/home.js (quick settings) and settings/index.html (full settings). issue #4: dictGroupEn/dictGroupRu used to duplicate every mode per dictionary language — merged into one dictGroupDpd; hasLangToggle marks it as having an En/Ru dictionary-language variant (value + 'ru' suffix), picked via a separate toggle in the UI instead of a second set of list entries. dictGroupOther has no language variant and is shown on every platform, not filtered by device.
